top_signals.title: Global Refinery Crunch Pushes Diesel Prices to New Records
top_signals.summary: U.S. diesel prices broke another record last week, topping $6.50 per gallon. In Europe, fuel prices are soaring, and shortages are looming over already struggling economies. There is simply not enough refining capacity in the world to make up for the loss of Middle Eastern and Russian barrels. And there is no quick fix. Last week, Russia said it would extend a ban on diesel exports until the end of October, as Ukrainian drone attacks on refineries continued, despite President Donald Trump’s call on the Zelensky government to stop attacking…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Texas Gov. Abbott orders data center permit halt weeks after issuing moratorium
top_signals.summary: Data centers have been a flash point in the 2026 midterm elections, including Abbott's bid for reelection against Democratic state Rep. Gina Hinojosa.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: 'Years of Growth Left': Grimba
top_signals.summary: RBC Capital Markets Director of Global ETF Strategy Valerie Grimba joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discuss the proliferation of new fund launches and how ETF issuers compete in an increasingly crowded space. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
